mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet_tag(pet_id, tag_code, note, created_at) VALUES (#{ownerId}, #{tagCode}, #{note}, #{createdAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM pet_tag WHERE pet_id = #{petId} AND tag_code = #{tagCode}
mapper.select: SELECT id, pet_id AS owner_id, tag_code, note, created_at FROM pet_tag WHERE pet_id = #{petId} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_tag(customer_id, tag_code, note, created_at) VALUES (#{ownerId}, #{tagCode}, #{note}, #{createdAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM customer_tag WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND tag_code = #{tagCode}
mapper.select: SELECT id, customer_id AS owner_id, tag_code, note, created_at FROM customer_tag WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO follow_up_task(customer_id, pet_id, type, due_on, status, source_type, source_id, note, created_at) VALUES (#{customerId}, #{petId}, #{type}, #{dueOn}, #{status}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{note}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT t.*, c.name AS customer_name, c.phone AS customer_phone, p.name AS pet_name FROM follow_up_task t JOIN customer c ON c.id = t.customer_id LEFT JOIN pet p ON p.id = t.pet_id WHERE t.id = #{id}

SELECT t.*, c.name AS customer_name, c.phone AS customer_phone, p.name AS pet_name FROM follow_up_task t JOIN customer c ON c.id = t.customer_id LEFT JOIN pet p ON p.id = t.pet_id WHERE t.status = 'PENDING' AND t.due_on <= #{date} ORDER BY CASE t.type WHEN 'COMPLAINT' THEN 1 WHEN 'CUSTOMER_BIRTHDAY' THEN 2 WHEN 'BIRTHDAY' THEN 3 WHEN 'SERVICE_FOLLOW_UP' THEN 4 WHEN 'RECALL' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END, t.due_on, t.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM follow_up_task WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND due_on <= #{date}
mapper.update: UPDATE follow_up_task SET status = #{status}, result = #{result}, operator = #{operator}, done_at = datetime('now','localtime') WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE follow_up_task SET due_on = #{dueOn} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE follow_up_task SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND due_on < #{before}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT b.customer_id AS customerId, b.pet_id AS petId FROM bill b JOIN bill_item i ON i.bill_id = b.id WHERE b.business_date = #{date} AND b.status = 'SETTLED' AND b.pet_id IS NOT NULL AND i.item_type IN ('SERVICE', 'BOARDING')

SELECT p.id AS petId, p.owner_id AS customerId, p.name AS petName, c.name AS customerName FROM pet p JOIN customer c ON c.id = p.owner_id WHERE p.is_active = 1 AND c.is_active = 1 AND p.birthday IS NOT NULL AND substr(p.birthday, 6, 5) = #{mmdd}

SELECT c.id AS customerId, c.name AS customerName, c.phone AS phone, IFNULL(SUM(b.received_cent), 0) AS totalSpent, MAX(b.business_date) AS lastVisit FROM customer c LEFT JOIN bill b ON b.customer_id = c.id AND b.status = 'SETTLED' WHERE c.is_active = 1 GROUP BY c.id HAVING lastVisit IS NOT NULL AND lastVisit < date(#{today}, '-' || #{days} || ' day') ORDER BY totalSpent DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO contact_log(customer_id, pet_id, task_id, channel, result, content, next_follow_on, operator, created_at) VALUES (#{customerId}, #{petId}, #{taskId}, #{channel}, #{result}, #{content}, #{nextFollowOn}, #{operator}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS billCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN bill_type = 'SALE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS saleCount, IFNULL(SUM(received_cent), 0) AS totalSpent, MAX(business_date) AS lastVisit FROM bill WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND status = 'SETTLED'

SELECT i.name_snapshot AS name, SUM(i.qty) AS qty FROM bill_item i JOIN bill b ON b.id = i.bill_id WHERE b.customer_id = #{customerId} AND b.status = 'SETTLED' AND i.item_type = 'SERVICE' GROUP BY i.name_snapshot ORDER BY qty DESC LIMIT 3
